nodes.name: Theorem 4.1: *+[F] Triangularity
nodes.statement:
\
\begin{enumerate}
    \item $\beta_{vw}=\langle [\mathcal O_{{ X}^w}(-\partial { X}^w)],[{\mathcal P}_v] \rangle$ vanishes unless $v\,w_0  \leq w$
    
    in the Bruhat order.
    \item $\alpha_{vw}=\langle [\mathcal O_{{ X}^+_w}],[{\mathcal Q}_v] \rangle$ vanishes unless 
    
    $w\leq v\,w_0$ in the Bruhat order.
    \item If $v\,w_0  = w$,  then $\alpha_{vw}=[{\sf k}_{ve_v}]$, $\beta_{vw}=[{\sf k}_{-ve_v}]$.
\end{enumerate}

nodes.name: Theorem 6.2: *+[F] $\mathrm R^i{\mathrm{ind}}_{\mathbf B}^ {\mathbf G} (P(\lambda)\otimes Q(\mu))=0$…
Theorem 6.5, Theorem 6.6: *+[F] Computing…
nodes.statement:
If ${\sf k}={\mathbb C}$, then
\begin{enumerate}
\item
${\mathrm{ind}}_{\mathbf B}^ {\mathbf G} (P(-e_v)\otimes Q(e_w))$ vanishes unless $w\leq v$.
\item
${\mathrm{ind}}_{\mathbf B}^ {\mathbf G} (P(-e_v)\otimes Q(e_v))={\sf k}$.
\end{enumerate}

Let ${\sf k}$ be a field or ${\mathbb Z}$.
Let $v,w\in W$.
\begin{enumerate}
\item $\mathrm R^i{\mathrm{ind}}_{\mathbf B}^{\mathbf G} (P(-e_v)\otimes Q(e_v))=\begin{cases}{\sf k} &\mbox{if $i=0$}\\
0&\mbox{else.}\end{cases}$
\item If $w\not\leq v$ then $\mathrm R^i{\mathrm{ind}}_{\mathbf B}^{\mathbf G} (P(-e_v)\otimes Q(e_w))=0$ for all $i$.
\end{enumerate}

nodes.name: Theorem 8.20: *+[F] Generation
nodes.statement:
The smallest strictly full additive subcategory  that 
  \begin{itemize}
  \item contains the $M_v$,  
  \item has the
  2 out of 3 property and 
  \item contains with every $e^\lambda$ and every fundamental representation $\nabla(\omega_i)$ also
   $e^\lambda\otimes\nabla(\omega_i)$,
  \end{itemize}
   is the category ${\mathrm{rep}}({\mathbf B})$ of finite dimensional ${\mathbf B}$-modules.
